checks.title: Does AAVSO start at the star's normal brightness?
checks.finding: first 60 days of V: median 15.03; Gaia DR3 (2014-17 mean) implies V = 15.57; difference -0.55 mag. The series begins mid-event: its own median is not the star's normal state.

checks.title: Colour of the variability (all simultaneous AAVSO data)
checks.finding: dB/dV = 0.95 (ISM dust 1.32, r = 0.65), dR/dV = 0.99 (ISM dust 0.81, r = 0.96), dI/dV = 0.93 (ISM dust 0.59, r = 0.95). At least one band does not track V: suspect calibration, a blend, or a band-specific artifact.
